blockers.quote: > CARD: PROBLEM 3 · Whoever holds it makes the bread cost more
blockers.why: Check #21, Close the loopholes on screen: giving away the entire balance would reach zero and stop the doubling. The film shows a partial giveaway but never answers this obvious exploit, weakening the bank correction and climax.
blockers.fix: Replace with: “Yes, giving away everything would stop the doubling. But five trillion new euros would remain in Berlin, chasing the same bread. Zero for you. Not for the city.”

blockers.quote: Day thirty-one. Ten million euros, pouring off your phone.
blockers.why: Check #15, Cold open inside the power: this is explicitly a flash-forward teaser from later, followed by a rewind, rather than the chronological moment the power first works.
blockers.fix: Replace lines 17–30 with chronological day two at the bakery: the phone tears from 0,01 to 0,02 while held toward Lotte in the thumbnail composition; the reader declines, Jonas pays, and the title question follows.

blockers.quote: A thousand drones take off. Eighty of them carry a roll. Forty thousand orders.
blockers.why: Check #11, Never say the feeling: this narrates exactly what line 271 already shows instead of landing the failed expectation.
blockers.fix: Replace with: “You bought a thousand deliveries. You did not make one more roll.”

suggestions.quote: Lotte: Your friend ordered thirty-one. Last night.
suggestions.fix: Replace with “Lotte: Thirty-one. Then thirty-one more.” so the sixty-two-cake reveal has a visible cause.

suggestions.quote: > SCENE: Day fifty-two. A TV studio, the anchor at her desk, silent under the narration: BREAKING across the bottom, a map of Berlin glowing gold behind her.
suggestions.fix: Remove the late-arriving anchor: show BREAKING on the bakery television while Lotte, Jonas and you watch the gold spread across the map.

suggestions.quote: > SCENE: Out past the Earth, past the stars: coins drifting among galaxies.
suggestions.fix: Carry the bakery image into the scale jump: make Lotte’s printed receipt unspool around Earth and continue past the stars toward the atom comparison.

keep.quote: Jonas: I don't know what to do with my hands when they win.
It isn't taken from anyone. Except it is. From everyone. A little. Every night.
